3162.title: The harness schemas
3162.content: Schema, Role, Actor, Skill, Voice, User Story, Process, Task and Test, each box read from the schema behind it; the stereotype names which. Colours are the five families in uml.css. Every arrow runs from the dependent to the general node: a Task realises the Skill it implements, a Voice and a User Story point at their Role, and a Test Run is checked against its Skill’s input and output schemas. Definitions: Actor · Role · Skill · Voice · User Story · Process · Task · JSON Schema · External Schema · Test Run · KG QA Report . Source: PlantUML · the full model, with Bean and Todo, is below.
